metaDescription: Free online HEX to RGB Converter. Instantly translate web color HEX codes into RGB formats. Essential for CSS and web development.
intro: Have a hex color code but need the RGB values to add an opacity channel in CSS? Our free HEX to RGB Converter instantly translates hexadecimal color strings into standard Red, Green, Blue integers.
whatIs: The HEX to RGB Converter is a design and development tool that takes a 6-character hexadecimal color code (used heavily in HTML/CSS) and translates it into an RGB format (used in design software and CSS rgba).
howToUse: Enter your 6-digit HEX code (e.g., FF5733). The '#' is optional.
The tool instantly parses the string.
The exact RGB values (0-255) are displayed alongside a visual color preview.
howItWorks: A 6-digit HEX code is actually three separate numbers. The tool splits the string into pairs (e.g., FF, 57, 33). It then uses base-16 to base-10 math to convert each pair into a decimal number between 0 and 255.
workedExample: You enter #00FF00. The tool splits it: Red is 00, Green is FF, Blue is 00. Hex '00' is decimal 0. Hex 'FF' is decimal 255. The tool outputs RGB(0, 255, 0), which is pure green.
resultInterpretation: The output is the exact ratio of Red, Green, and Blue light a computer monitor must emit to display the target color.
useCases: CSS Transparency: Converting a HEX to RGB so you can write `rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)` for a 50% transparent background.
Software Integrations: Entering colors into legacy software or game engines that only accept 0-255 RGB inputs.
Design Handoff: Ensuring a graphic designer using RGB in Photoshop has the exact same color as the developer using HEX.
tipsAndLimitations: The tool supports 3-digit shorthand HEX codes (like #F00). It automatically expands it to #FF0000 before converting.
Hex codes are not case-sensitive. #ff0000 and #FF0000 are mathematically identical.

faq.question: Can I convert an 8-digit HEX code?
faq.answer: 8-digit hex codes include an alpha (transparency) channel. Standard 6-digit to RGB converters will ignore the last two digits. You would need a HEX to RGBA converter for the opacity value.

faq.question: Why use RGB instead of HEX?
faq.answer: While HEX is shorter to type, RGB makes it much easier to programmatically manipulate colors, such as dynamically changing opacity (RGBA) or calculating color contrast ratios in JavaScript.

cta: Convert your HEX codes to RGB now!
disclaimer: This tool strictly mathematically converts base-16 color codes to base-10. Assumes standard sRGB color space.
